verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TULINA Kbaka waffe
Eyava mu ggulu:
Kale fenna abaana be
Tumugoberere.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Okwagala kwe kungi nnyo
Eri-abantu bonna;
Naffe twagale bannaffe
Nga bwe kiyinzika.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Yesu tayagala kibi
Na kwerowoozaako;
Ye omulabe we y'ani,
Amulyamu-olukwe?

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ayagala tulongoose
Emibiri gyaffe;
Abatali batukuvu
Tebaliba naye.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Tuli kibiina kitono,
Naye tusaanidde
Okutwalira Katonda
-Emyoyo-emirongoofu.
